bio: Lusis was given an incredible gift: the Blades of the Tempest, sacred weapons for taming the spirits of the storms. Her Clan had used them to calm the winds for generations, but Lusis had no interest in calm. For her, the fury of storms is a key to riches the likes of which her Clan has never seen.
